subject: health
title: Ask for Help
about: Who his trusted adults are at home, at school and in the community, telling them when something feels unsafe or a secret feels bad, and trying another way when a problem is hard. NC 1.MEH.2 (more than one way to solve a problem, who can help) and 1.ICHR.1.3 and 1.ICHR.1.6.
tip: After the deck, have him name his own three trusted adults out loud: one at home, one at school, one in town.

cards.q: What do you call a grown-up you know well who keeps you safe?
cards.note: A trusted adult is a grown-up you know well, like a parent or a teacher.

cards.q: Who is a trusted adult at home?
cards.note: A guardian is the grown-up who takes care of you at home.

cards.q: Who is a trusted adult at school?
wrong: a visitor you do not know
cards.note: The principal and the school nurse are trusted adults too.

cards.q: Who is a trusted adult in your community?
wrong: a person you do not know
cards.note: Nurses and librarians are community helpers too.

cards.q: You feel unsafe or scared. What do you do?
cards.note: Telling a trusted adult is always the right thing to do.

cards.q: Someone asks you to keep a secret that makes you feel bad. What do you do?
cards.note: A secret that feels bad is never one to keep.

cards.q: You tell a grown-up, but they are busy. What do you do next?
cards.note: Keep asking until a grown-up listens.

cards.q: Your block tower keeps falling. What can you do?
cards.note: Make the bottom wider or stack more slowly. There is more than one way to build it.

cards.q: One way to fix a problem did not work. What now?
cards.note: There is more than one way to solve a problem. Think of a new idea, or ask for help.

cards.q: You cannot open your juice box. Who can help?
cards.note: It is okay to ask for help with small things too.

cards.q: You have a problem at school. Who can help?
cards.note: A counselor is a grown-up at school who helps with feelings and problems.

cards.q: If you practice a lot, what will your skills be?
cards.note: The more you practice, the better you get.
